description: GitHub repository search: find public repositories by keyword, optionally in one language, ordered by best match, stars, forks or last update, with each result's stars, forks, language, topics, license and last-push date; 1-20 results. Repositories only, no user profile data. Use to find a library for a task, discover the popular projects on a topic or check what already exists before building. Example: q=x402 payments. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

language.description: Only repositories mainly in this language, e.g. TypeScript

q.description: Search words, e.g. x402 payments (GitHub search qualifiers such as topic:mcp or stars:>100 work too)

name: github_search
title: GitHub search: find repositories
